visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three female performers wearing purple cheerleading uniforms are positioned on a polished basketball court. The central woman is kneeling on one knee, smiling directly at the camera, while the two others stand slightly behind her in a triangle formation. The background features stadium seating filled with spectators under bright purple and white spotlights. (2) The dancers rise in unison and begin a synchronized arm routine, stretching their arms vertically above their heads before sweeping them down and out to the sides. The lead dancer has long dark hair adorned with a large white bow, and her facial expression is consistently cheerful and expressive. (3) The camera follows the lead dancer as she executes a series of rhythmic hip sways and hand gestures, moving with high physical intensity. The background spectators are visible but softly blurred, creating a focus on the foreground action. (4) The choreography transitions into more complex jumping and stepping patterns, where the dancers maintain perfect synchronization. The central performer briefly turns her back to the camera, revealing a jersey number on her top, before rotating back to face forward. (5) The routine concludes with a final coordinated pose where the lead dancer returns to a kneeling position, making a 'call me' hand sign while the other two dancers frame her from behind. The studio-style lighting remains constant throughout.
